text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Toronto Transit Commission has undertaken the installation of a duct bank and pavement rehabilitation on the south side of Harlandale Avenue, between Yonge Street and Beecroft Road. At its meeting of February 22, 2024, North York Community Council authorized the temporary closure of the south sidewalk, eastbound traffic lane and the on-street parking spaces on both sides of Harlandale Avenue, from February 29, 2024 to September 30, 2024. Toronto Transit Commission has requested an extension of the duration of the construction staging area on Harlandale Avenue, as the site has experienced a number of construction delays due to multiple conflicts with underground utilities.
